attchmntText: Jamna Auto Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Jamna Auto Industries Limited filed an investor presentation for the un-audited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved an interim dividend of Rs 1 per equity share. Consolidated net sales for Q2 FY 2026-27 were Rs 786 crore, with EBITDA at Rs 108 crore and PAT at Rs 56 crore. For the half year, net sales stood at Rs 1397 crore and PAT at Rs 105 crore. The company acquired Owen Springs Limited, completed on 1 September 2026. A new conventional leaf spring production line of 1,500 MT per month is being relocated from Adityapur to Malanpur. Production readiness at Indore awaits administrative approval expected in November 2026. The company secured a stabilizer bar business award from Daimler India Commercial Vehicles.

attchmntText: Jamna Auto Industries Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Jamna Auto Industries Limited has decided to set up a new Leaf Spring manufacturing facility at its existing plant in Malanpur, Madhya Pradesh. This decision was taken by the Board of Directors on November 14, 2026. The facility will add a capacity of 1,500 MT per month to the existing 9,000 MT per month. Commercial production is expected to start around December 2027. The proposed investment is around Rs. 47 crore, primarily through internal accruals. This expansion aims to cater to a wider customer base across Northern, Central, and Western India.

attchmntText: Jamna Auto Industries Limited has informed the Exchange that Record date for the purpose of Dividend  is 20-Nov-2026.
voiceSummary: Jamna Auto Industries Limited approved its un-audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The company declared an interim dividend of Rs. 1.00 per equity share for the financial year 2026-27. The record date for dividend eligibility is set for November 20, 2026. Limited review reports on the financial results were also approved. The statutory auditors issued unmodified opinions on these reports. The board meeting took place on November 14, 2026, starting at 12:15 p.m. and concluding at 01:40 p.m.
